article.title: 澳洲Bench Media在Bench Connect加入廣告分析助理Aura
article.summary: 澳洲媒體代理商Bench Media在Bench Connect推出Aura，讓行銷人員以英文查詢廣告活動數據。
highlights: Aura可協助比較不同投放平台的表現。
創意及成效團隊可分別追查素材疲勞跡象和獲客成本變化。
article.why: 媒體團隊可以先追查異常屬於單一受眾、素材或整個活動，再決定是否調整廣告。
article.next_step: 以已具基準數據的活動測試提問，並與各平台原始報表比對時間範圍及轉換定義。
article.detail: 據Mediaweek報道，Bench Connect彙集活動表現、受眾與廣告分析資料，Aura讓團隊以英文追問這些資料。Bench Media的產品主管以轉換上升為例，說明團隊可以再追問變化是否集中於某一受眾。這類查詢可協助提出待驗證的假設，換素材或改預算前仍可回查原始報表。
article.title_en: Australia's Bench Media adds ad analysis assistant Aura to Bench Connect
article.summary_en: Australian media agency Bench Media launched Aura inside Bench Connect so marketers can ask questions about campaign data in English.
highlights_en: Aura can compare performance across ad platforms.
Creative and performance teams can investigate signs of creative fatigue and increases in acquisition cost.
article.why_en: Media teams can check whether an anomaly relates to one audience, one asset or the entire campaign before making changes.
article.next_step_en: Test questions on a campaign with a known baseline and reconcile date ranges and conversion definitions against platform reports.
article.detail_en: Mediaweek reports that Bench Connect combines campaign performance, audience and advertising data, which teams can explore in English through Aura. Bench Media's product lead used higher conversions as an example of a change teams can investigate at audience level. Treat the answers as hypotheses and consult the underlying reports before refreshing creative or moving spend.
